quarterly_data.quarter: CleanSpark press release: CleanSpark Releases August 2026 Operational Update (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CEO and Chairman Matt Schultz: strong construction progress continues at the Sandersville site for its high-investment grade tenant (campus with $6.6 billion in contracted revenue). In Texas, as part of Governor Abbott's audit directive with ERCOT and the PUCT, CleanSpark received notice of conditional classification by ERCOT for 585 MW of contracted capacity to receive batch zero baseload designation and 300 MW to receive batch zero studied load designation, 'as expected', for both Texas sites. August 2026 power portfolio (unaudited): 1.8 GW under contract, 808 MW utilized in support of the mining fleet.
quarterly_data.figure: ERCOT conditional batch zero: 585 MW baseload, 300 MW studied load; 808 MW utilized of 1.8 GW under contract
